grammar_focus: KS10/34/58 被动语态各时态(教材 L82 Key structures,方案B换情节包):一般过去被动(was found/was covered/was cleaned)、现在进行被动(is being examined)、现在完成被动(have been seen)、过去完成被动(had been forgotten)、一般现在被动(is kept/is checked)、将来被动(will be shown);辅以易混词 laugh vs laugh at、wash vs wash up
scene: 上周,在一座老房子的阁楼里发现了一件古怪的旧物。它落满灰尘,已被遗忘了一百多年。起初,一家人还嘲笑它,以为是废物。可当把它清理干净后,底下露出一个奇特的图案。如今,这件物品正由城里博物馆的专家们鉴定。“这样的东西以前只被见过几次,”一位专家说。“得先仔细研究,才能说清它是什么。”每一件珍贵的物品都被保存在一个专门的房间里,每天都有人检查。下个月,这件神秘的物品将第一次向公众展出。那家曾经嘲笑它的人,如今为它将在博物馆展出而感到自豪。

grammar_card.title: KS10/34/58 被动语态各时态
grammar_card.intro: 被动语态 = be + 过去分词,“被…”的意思;时态的变化体现在 be 上:①一般过去 was/were done(was found 被发现);②现在进行 is/are being done(is being examined 正在被鉴定);③现在完成 have/has been done(have been seen 被见过);④过去完成 had been done(had been forgotten 曾被遗忘);⑤一般现在 is/are done(is kept 被保存);⑥将来 will be done(will be shown 将被展出)。SD:laugh(笑)vs laugh at(嘲笑);wash(洗)vs wash up(洗餐具/冲上岸)。

rows: 现在完成 / 过去完成
have been seen / had been forgotten
laugh at(嘲笑) / wash up(洗餐具)

specialRules.rule: 美语里“垃圾”说 trash(英式 rubbish)、“手电筒”说 flashlight(英式 torch)、“公寓”说 apartment(英式 flat);本课已按美语写。
被动语态时态变化都在 be 上,过去分词不变:was done / is being done / has been done / will be done。laugh at = 嘲笑(取笑某人某事),laugh = 单纯地笑。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Where was the strange object found?
options: In the attic of an old house
At the bottom of the sea

passage: Last week, a strange old object was found in the attic of an old house. It was covered in dust and had been forgotten for over a hundred years. At first the family laughed at it, thinking it was junk. But when it was cleaned, a curious pattern was discovered underneath. Now the object is being examined by experts at the city museum. "Things like this have been seen only a few times before," one expert said. "It is carefully studied before anyone can say what it is." Every valuable piece is kept in a special room and is checked daily. Next month, the mysterious object will be shown to the public for the first time. The family who once laughed at it are now proud that it will be displayed in a museum.
